subject: english
title: Unit 6 Grammar 2
subtitle: Future predictions with will and won't, from the Grammar Workbook chart.

content: Predict what will happen to the ocean if pollution and overfishing continue.
Say what people will and won't do to protect the planet.
Sort ten Student Book sentences into will and won't.
language: Use will and won't with the base verb to make predictions.
Ask and answer questions with will, including short answers.
Recognise won't as the contraction of will not.
